recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-safe browser canvas game called **Grimwhisker: Sewer Rogue**. It is a dark mutant sewer-dojo collision sandbox centered on a talking masked raccoon rogue. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: the player starts the game, three objects spawn, a button spawns one additional object, canvas objects can be dragged by mouse or touch, overlapping objects are removed with particles, the HUD displays active object count, and reset clears all active objects. Rebuild presentation as procedural sewer art: ooze river, brick tunnels, raccoon sigils, claw marks, comic-noir UI, purple mask accents, green radioactive glow, and relic objects such as masks, ooze vials, sewer lids, batons, pizza contraband, and trap fans.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: single-screen top-down canvas physics toy / collision sandbox
- objective: start play, spawn draggable objects, crash objects together so they disappear, and monitor the active-object count
- input model: click/touch buttons for start/spawn/reset; mouse/touch drag on canvas entities
- core loop: start -> spawn three items -> optionally spawn more -> drag items into collisions -> collision removes both items and emits particles -> HUD count updates -> reset clears all
- fail/friction state: no formal fail/win; overcrowding is feedback only, and reset is always available

## Protected mechanics
- Three initial spawned objects when play begins.
- Spawn button adds one random entity at a padded random canvas position.
- Drag starts on top-most hit entity, follows pointer/touch, and releases on pointer/touch end.
- Entity update uses friction, bounce at viewport bounds, and requestAnimationFrame rendering.
- Pairwise distance collision removes all colliding entities, creates particles, and updates the active count.
- Reset clears the active entity list and keeps the game running.
- HUD count equals the number of active entities; no new win/loss/timer/health semantics were added.

## Remixed target
A dark mutant sewer-dojo collision sandbox starring Grimwhisker, a talking masked raccoon rogue. The same spawn/drag/collide/reset loop is reframed as dropping stolen sewer relics into a shadow stash, dragging them into ooze-lit clashes, and flushing the tunnel when the stash gets chaotic.
